The '''Hasiki system''' was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hasikian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="WildSpace" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> and fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hasiki [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA" />
